features: 240W Fast Charging - The USB 4 Thunderbolt 4 cable supports charging speeds up to 240W (48V, 5A), providing maximum power for compatible devices. It can charge a wide range of USB-C devices, from phones and accessories to laptops.

40Gbps High Speed Transfer - The USB-C to Thunderbolt 4 cable offers data transfer speeds of up to 40Gbps, which is four times faster than USB 3.2 (Gen 1). This high-speed cable can transfer 14 hours of HD video or 25,000 photos in just one minute. Please Note actual data transfer speeds may vary depending on the capabilities of the host and connected devices.

Single 8K & Dual 4K - The USB 4 Cable supports a single 8K display feed and dual 4K video display, and connects directly to an external monitor via the Thunderbolt 4 port, giving you more screen real estate and higher resolution. Whether you're watching high-definition movies, recording video or processing images, it's easy to handle.

Durable Quality - The USB-C Thunderbolt 4 cable features a stylish nylon braided exterior combined with an aluminium alloy shell for exceptional durability. Additionally, it is equipped with gold-plated terminals that enhance connectivity and reduce signal loss.
Experience Exceptional Fast Charging: Enjoy the power of a maximum 240W charge with this Portronics USB-C to USB-C cable when paired with a compatible charger.
